concern_details.detail: main components in the registration process, their responsibilities, interactions and dependencies
concern_details.why: The six lifelines follow the real call chain: AuthenticationController.register:29-30 -> LibraryFacade.register (pass-through, merged) -> UserManager.register:65-97 -> UserRegistry (institutionalEmailExists, findStudentByStudentNumber/findLibrarianByCode, registerUser) -> PersistenceManager.save, plus the per-role factory (UserManager.java:89-90). The messages make the dependencies and order clear.

concern_details.detail: which components handle the request, validate personal data and role, manage role-specific data (student ID, librarian identifier), check validity and uniqueness, and persist the new user
concern_details.why: Request handling, role guards, the two uniqueness lookups, factory choice and persistence are all shown correctly. But the validation self-message (03) says only 'validate role, name, password; [Student] ID format / [Librarian] code'. It leaves out checks that UserManager makes in the same step: surname format, and the email format and institutional domain (validateEmail -> REGEX_EMAIL_ISTITUZIONALE '...unina.it', UserManager.java:26,152-153,201-212, called from validateStudent/validateLibrarian:175,185). It also leaves out the alphanumeric identifier check used for both roles (validateIdentifier:214-221). A tester reading the view would not know that a non-unina.it email is a validation failure (400) and not a uniqueness case.

concern_details.detail: how they collaborate when invalid or already existing data is provided
concern_details.why: There are separate branches for invalid data/role, email already associated, identifier already in use, and save failure. Each has the message text from the code (UserManager.java:78,85,94). They return to AuthenticationController, and one HTTP response goes to the client. The note gives the RestExceptionHandler mapping: IllegalArgumentException -> 400 {error} (RestExceptionHandler.java:19-22). The unmapped save RuntimeException is correctly flagged as Spring's default and is not claimed as a 400.

concern_details.detail: main integration points and interactions the tests should cover
concern_details.why: The view shows each integration point: client->controller over HTTP, the controller's exception-to-HTTP mapping, UserManager->UserRegistry (two lookups plus registerUser), UserManager->factory per role, and UserRegistry->PersistenceManager.save with its boolean result as the [not saved]/[saved] guard (PersistenceManager.java:19-43). The Swing path, which bypasses the controller, is noted. The only gap is the validation scope described above.

level_why: 6 lifelines and 14 numbered messages with three nested alts suit a balanced view for an integration tester. Merging the LibraryFacade pass-through into UserManager, putting the lookup calls to PersistenceManager.findFirstByFields in a note, and using guards instead of reply arrows all keep it at the given level. Nothing needs cutting. The fix asked for below is a label change, not an added element, so the view stays at the same level.
unsupported: Message 03's label suggests that validation covers only role, name, password and the role-specific identifier. The code also validates the surname and the email (format, max length, unina.it domain) in the same step (UserManager.java:173-212). The label understates what is validated, so it is not an invented element, but it is inaccurate.
missing: Email validity (institutional unina.it domain, format) and surname as part of the 'invalid data' branch. This is a main invalid-input case for the tests, and validateEmail in UserManager.java:201-212 shows it.
uml: The single lifeline 'Student / Librarian Factory' stands for two classes. In the code, a new factory is created per call depending on role (UserManager.java:89). A lifeline should represent one participant, so name it by the interface it is used through ('factory : UserFactory') and keep the role guard on createUser.

UserManager's activation extends past AuthenticationController's reply to the client (deactivate um after message 14). The callee's execution should end when it returns to the controller, which is before the HTTP response.
fixes: Widen the validation self-message 03 to cover all personal data: 'validate role, name/surname, institutional email (@unina.it), password; [Student] ID [A-Z]\d{8} / [Librarian] alphanumeric code'. The tester can then see that a non-institutional email takes the [invalid data or role] -> 400 path.
Rename the factory lifeline to one participant typed by the interface ('factory : UserFactory'), keeping the [Student] StudentFactory / [Librarian] LibrarianFactory guard on createUser.
End UserManager's activation at its return to AuthenticationController, before message 14.
